mn62:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn62:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn62:2.2: Āyasmā pi kho Rāhulo pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn62:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā apaloketvā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn62:3.2: Yaṃ kiñci Rāhula rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ, ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā, oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā, hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbanti. --
mn62:3.3: Rūpam-eva nu kho Bhagavā, rūpam-eva nu kho Sugatāti. --
mn62:3.4: Rūpam-pi Rāhula, vedanā pi Rāhula, saññā pi Rāhula, saṅkhārā pi Rāhula, viññāṇam-pi Rāhulāti.
mn62:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo: ko n' ajja Bhagavatā sammukhā ovādena ovadito gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisissatīti tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn62:5.1: Addasā kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā,
mn62:5.4: ānāpānasati Rāhula bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti.
mn62:6.1: Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rāhulo Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn62:7.1: Kathaṃ bhāvitā nu kho bhante ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti.
mn62:8.1: Yaṃ kiñci Rāhula ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:8.2: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā pan' aññam-pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ,
mn62:8.4: Yā c' eva kho pana ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu paṭhavīdhātur-ev' esā.
mn62:8.5: Taṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:8.6: Evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati, paṭhavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:9.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:9.5: pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ, yaṃ vā pan' aññam-pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ,
mn62:9.7: Yā c' eva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu āpodhātur-ev' esā
mn62:9.8: Taṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:9.9: Evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āpodhātuyā nibbindati, āpodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:10.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
mn62:10.5: yena ca santappati yena ca jiriyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā pan' aññam-pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ,
mn62:10.7: Yā c' eva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu tejodhātur-ev' esā.
mn62:10.8: Taṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn62:10.9: Evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā tejodhātuyā nibbindati, tejodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn62:11.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādiṇṇaṃ, seyyathīdaṃ

mn62:11.7: Yā c' eva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu vāyodhātur-ev' esā.
mn62:11.8: Taṃ: n' etaṃ mama, n' eso 'ham-asmi, na me^so attā ti evam-etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. \ [...

mn62:24.3: Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca Rāhula ānāpānasati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā:
mn62:25.1: Idha Rāhula bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn62:25.2: So sato va assasati, sato passasati.
mn62:26.1: Dīghaṃ vā assasanto: dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto: dīghaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti;
mn62:26.2: rassaṃ vā assasanto: rassaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto: rassaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti.
mn62:26.3: Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
mn62:26.4: Passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
